name: prometheus.exporter.consul

arguments.name: allow_stale
arguments.description: Allows any Consul server (non-leader) to service a read.

arguments.name: ca_file
arguments.description: File path to a PEM-encoded certificate authority used to validate the authenticity of a server certificate.

arguments.name: cert_file
arguments.description: File path to a PEM-encoded certificate used with the private key to verify the exporter’s authenticity.

arguments.name: concurrent_request_limit
arguments.description: Limit the maximum number of concurrent requests to consul, 0 means no limit.

arguments.name: generate_health_summary
arguments.description: Collects information about each registered service and exports consul_catalog_service_node_healthy.

arguments.name: key_file
arguments.description: File path to a PEM-encoded private key used with the certificate to verify the exporter’s authenticity.

arguments.name: kv_filter
arguments.description: Only store keys that match this regular expression pattern.

arguments.name: kv_prefix
arguments.description: Prefix under which to look for KV pairs.

arguments.name: require_consistent
arguments.description: Forces the read to be fully consistent.

arguments.name: server_name
arguments.description: When provided, this overrides the hostname for the TLS certificate. It can be used to ensure that the certificate name matches the hostname you declare.

arguments.name: server
arguments.description: Address (host and port) of the Consul instance to connect to. This could be a local Alloy (localhost:8500), or the address of a Consul server.

arguments.name: timeout
arguments.description: Timeout on HTTP requests to consul.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
